additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We have received the following recommendation from HQ regarding this issue, stating that an on-site service visit is advised.
This charger is still showing abnormal temperature behavior, with higher-than-normal temperature differences and several DC Temperature Events recorded within the past month. The other outlet on the same charger operates normally, indicating that the problem is localized to this specific outlet.
We kindly request your support with a detailed investigation. If field service intervention is required please let us know

additional_info.subject: 0467134 - ID0467134-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / P9 170000775] Converter missing_ DC2 CRM:03208000071
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0467134
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Trugo
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Highway Outlet-1
Charger ID / Serial No.:
vgcKOK
Charger address/functional location: Highway 1, Bolu, TR
Priority:
High
Handover reason:
For the converter that is missing, it's on the DC4 group:
Unfortunately, I cannot specify which one is missing due to the algorithm, what you need to do is confirm from the list below, which one is missing.
First thing you should check is the CAN communication cables (black and white) if they are properly attached to the connector and to the converter input:
If the problem persists, please try swapping this converter with the neighbor one, for example, swap position/cables of TB5 and TB6.
If the problem persists, replace the converter.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Harun Ar Rashid
